policy_decision.common_table_rule: Read one official manufacturer table once for one formula version and market, then bind it separately to listed flavours when serving basis matches and the page shows no separate table or tracked-active dose change.
policy_decision.candy_ice_blast_correction: Breathe Easy is presented as a flavour addition and is not, by itself, evidence that caffeine, citrulline, beta-alanine or creatine doses differ. Existing applied data was not changed.

per4m.decision: No collector, table download, private archive or transcription was run for products 789 or 882.
